subject: Re: Capacity window & credits safeguard for SkyFleet pilot
messages:
From: Lina Park <ops@skyfleet.ai>
To: grace.oconnor@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@skyfleet.ai
Date: 2026-10-25T15:04:00-07:00
Subject: Post-demo follow-up: burn profile & short-term runway

Thanks again for the demo today — really helpful to see the routing and KV caching behavior. Two quick things from our side as we kick the pilot into a heavier week: 

1) Current burn: attached is a 48-hour sample (csv) showing live prompt/response token counts and peak QPS across our staging cluster.
2) Budget ask: we need to understand the minimum top-up to keep production traffic live for ~10 days if usage doubles. Our procurement lead is looped for approvals.

Primary questions: what is the target unit economics you’d use to estimate a $/1M-tokens number for our configuration (gpt-large-ish + 2k context, KV cache on), and do you have a short-term safeguard credit you can provision while we finalize a committed capacity conversation?

Attaching: skyfleet-usage-sample.csv

--
Lina Park
Ops Lead, SkyFleet
ops@skyfleet.ai
From: grace.oconnor@redwood.com
To: Lina Park <ops@skyfleet.ai>, Arjun Mehta <cto@skyfleet.ai>
Cc: aditya.rao@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com, procurement@skyfleet.ai
Date: 2026-10-26T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo follow-up: burn profile & short-term runway

Lina — thanks for the note and the CSV, appreciated. Quick recap and proposed steps so we’re aligned:

Recap from our side
- Observed on your sample: peak bursts ~120 QPS, median ~18 QPS, average response tokens per request ~420 (with a 2k context hit in ~8% of calls).
- With your current runtime settings (64-bit KV cached, batch target 60ms), our conservative unit-econ we estimate at ~$850 per 1M output tokens for this workload shape. That includes expected batching benefits and cache hit rates you showed.

Proposed short-term plan
1) Provisional credit: we can provision a safety-net credit of $8,500 (equivalent to ~10M tokens at the conservative rate) for a 14-day window while procurement finalizes terms. This is a provisional, one-time top-up tied to pilot health checks.
2) Monitoring & guardrails: we’ll enable token-level alerts and a burn-rate webhook to your ops channel so we can pause or top-up automatically if daily burn > 1.6M tokens/day.
3) Next steps: if you confirm you want the provisional credit, procurement can sign the short MAV (mutual action plan) and we’ll spin the credit within 24 hours. We’ll also run a quick load test (10–20 minutes at target burst) to validate the estimate.

Ask from you
- Can procurement confirm internal PO number or whether a PO will be issued after the two-week extension?
- Any changes to expected peak concurrency over the next 10 days? If expected bursts exceed 200 QPS we’ll re-evaluate the top-up.

I’ve attached the provisional credit note we’ll sign (pdf) and a short MAV draft. Looping Aditya from FinOps for quick approval on the credit grant and Ben for success/CS coordination.

Attachments: redwood-provisional-credit-note.pdf, MAV_SkyFleet_2week.docx

Thanks — happy to hop on a 15-min sync if that’s faster.

Best,
Grace O’Connor
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0192
From: aditya.rao@redwood.com
To: grace.oconnor@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Cc: Lina Park <ops@skyfleet.ai>, Arjun Mehta <cto@skyfleet.ai>, procurement@skyfleet.ai
Date: 2026-10-27T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo follow-up: burn profile & short-term runway

Grace — I reviewed the attached CSV and the proposed $8,500 provisional credit. From a FinOps perspective I approve a one-time credit of up to $9,000 to account for any burst overshoot during the two-week window, provided we capture:
- A signed MAV with explicit duration and success criteria (uptime, AUP, basic security checklist)
- A quick call with your SRE if bursts exceed the expected threshold so we can temporarily increase pooling.

I’ll send a short internal approval note and Mark the billing account for the credit hold. Grace — please confirm we have a HubSpot record and the PO workflow so we can book the credit against deal SF-2026-10-PLT-42.

—Aditya Rao
Director, FinOps, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com
From: Arjun Mehta <cto@skyfleet.ai>
To: grace.oconnor@redwood.com, aditya.rao@redwood.com
Cc: Lina Park <ops@skyfleet.ai>, procurement@skyfleet.ai
Date: 2026-10-28T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo follow-up: burn profile & short-term runway

Grace / Aditya — appreciate the quick turnaround. We’ll accept the provisional credit and the two-week MAV provided you can:

- Include an explicit pause-trigger when daily burn > 1.8M tokens/day (we don’t want surprise overages)
- Provide the MAV PDF we can sign electronically (procurement prefers DocuSign or emailed PDF with signature lines)
- Confirm the PO flow: procurement will issue a PO that references the credit hold; we’ll share the PO number within 48 hours.

Quoted for visibility: 
> Grace — proposed top-up $8,500 (10M tokens conservative estimate).

We’ll also schedule a 20-min SRE sync on Friday to review expected burst handling; Lina will book that.

—Arjun Mehta
CTO, SkyFleet
cto@skyfleet.ai
From: grace.oconnor@redwood.com
To: Arjun Mehta <cto@skyfleet.ai>, Lina Park <ops@skyfleet.ai>, procurement@skyfleet.ai
Cc: aditya.rao@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-30T11:17:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo follow-up: burn profile & short-term runway

Thanks Arjun — confirming next steps and commitments from Redwood: 

1) Credit grant: Redwood will provision up to $9,000 provisional credit (safety-net) for SkyFleet pilot once MAV is signed and PO reference is provided. The credit will be valid for 14 calendar days from provision.
2) Pause-trigger: we will enable a hard pause at 1.8M tokens/day and a warning webhook at 1.4M/day.
3) Signatures & PO: I’ve attached the MAV draft (MAV_SkyFleet_2week.docx) and the provisional credit note (redwood-provisional-credit-note.pdf). Procurement should return a PO with a reference to deal SF-2026-10-PLT-42; we will bank the credit against that PO on receipt.
4) Load verification: Ben from CS will run the 15–20 minute burst test with your SRE, scheduled for Friday; please send available windows.

Attaching again: redwood-provisional-credit-note.pdf, MAV_SkyFleet_2week.docx

If procurement sends the PO by EOD Wednesday we’ll target credit provisioning by Thursday morning.

Thanks all — looking forward to keeping this moving.

Best,
Grace O’Connor
